Brand pack. Every file is generated by the scripts in the company wiki, wiki/products/circlists/brand/scripts/.

Logo

One mark, one wordmark, one lockup. The mark is three concentric circles: sage halo, white ring, emerald disc. The wordmark is "Circlists" outlined from Inter Bold (700) at −0.01 em, so it needs no font; the second i carries the emerald tittle. In the lockup the mark's halo is 1.5× the wordmark's cap height, centred on the cap midpoint, with a gap of 0.4× cap.

Lockup

Ink for light grounds, and reversed (cream) for dark grounds.

Wordmark

The tittle is ⌀ 0.25 × cap height, its centre raised to 1.18 × cap height above the baseline. It floats above the caps and reads a touch larger than the native i dot.

Mark

At 120 and 64 px the SVG; at 32 and 16 px the favicon PNGs, which is what ships at those sizes. The halo is opaque, so the mark holds on a light or a dark ground with no help. The halo reaches 46.5 of the 48 box (r 22.5 about the centre), so the mark carries no built-in padding.

Icons

The bare mark is the favicon: transparent, full size, no tile. The halo is opaque, so it reads at 16 px on a light or a dark tab. Installed icons sit on cream #FAFAF7 with the halo at 72% of the tile.

In a browser tab

The plain favicon and the notification icon on the four tab grounds. The small label under each tab is not part of the tab.

16 px, zoomed

The notification icon is for a tab that has something waiting: the mark plus an emerald arrival badge low right, built from the mark's own white keyline. The badge deliberately breaks the halo silhouette, which is what makes it detectable at 16 px. Swap it in while something waits and swap back when nothing does. It is a state, not a redrawing. Each at 6× (nearest neighbour) on light and dark, with the real 16 and 32 px sizes on the four tab grounds beneath.

Installed icons

Ground cream #FAFAF7, the halo at 72% of the tile, a hard square (the phone rounds it). The dashed circle is the maskable safe zone (40% of the edge): the halo reaches 90% of it, inside. Apple touch is 180 px; maskable is 512 px shown smaller. Each sits on a grey backing with an outline only so the cream tile's square edge can be seen; the backing is not part of the icon.

App icons

Installed, store and native icons, all generated from the mark: ground cream #FAFAF7, the halo at 72% of the tile. Each sits on a grey backing only so the cream tile's edge can be seen; the backing is not part of the icon.

icon-* is the PWA any icon with its corners baked round (transparent outside), for desktop, which shows it unmasked. maskable-* is a hard square that the phone cuts to its own shape: shown under a circle, a squircle and a rounded square, each with the 40% safe circle dashed. The notification badge is the mark as a single-colour silhouette with the ring cut out as a gap; Android tints it.

The 108 dp adaptive layer: icon-background.png and icon-foreground.png, each inset 16.7% a side by @capacitor/assets, so the 1024 px source lands on the 72 dp visible tile (solid outline). The dashed circle is the 66 dp zone no launcher mask cuts; the halo is about 51.8 dp across, inside it and inside Android's 48–66 dp logo guide. Themed (Android 13+) tints ic_launcher_monochrome.xml, the mark as a silhouette, drawn here from the preview PNG.

The three Xcode appearance slots: icon-only.png (opaque), ios-icon-dark.png (the mark on transparency, so the system's dark ground shows through) and ios-icon-tinted.png (the silhouette in white on black; iOS tints by brightness, so the shape is the light part). The App Store icon is icon-only.png at the same size.

Motion

Three animated treatments of the same mark: pulse, spinner and micro. Each is a self-contained SVG with its motion and its reduced-motion fallback inside, and each freezes to the static mark under reduced motion. Never redraw the mark.

The idle breathing mark. The sage halo breathes and brightens in lockstep while the disc and white ring hold still: a 3 s cycle, peak scale 1.075, brightness peaking at 1.09 at the 34% apex. It runs on linear timing because the hand-sampled curve is the motion: a brisk inhale, a brief apex, a relaxed exhale. In this asset the disc is drawn one step larger (r 15.2, ring r 15.875) so the resting sage band is thinner; the static mark is unchanged.

The loading state. The disc and white ring hold at centre; a sage arc on r 19.05 (band 5.3) rotates while its length grows and shrinks. The file ships at 1.4× the reference pace: rotation 1.369 s, arc-breathe 1.786 s. Where a surface inlines it, a live speed multiplier can vary the pace. No accompanying text by default: the ARIA label carries the loading state.

The ~10 px live signal dot. The green core holds dead still and a soft band of sage light sweeps across the halo, painting it into view as a ring around the core, then rests off-frame: a 3.8 s cycle on cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.15, 1), the band travelling 86 viewBox units over the first 64%. Nothing scales, so nothing reads as a pulse. It is built for this size; pulse and spinner scale to context.

Colour

Every value is the brand spec's, and each is checked against the prototype's tokens.css. The text neutrals are warm-leaning and AA on cream and white. A hex button copies it.

Type

Two families from Google Fonts, as in the prototype's tokens.css. Buttons are owed: there is no ladder yet, so tiers, fills and sizes are undefined.

Link text

Two forms, split by whether the link sits in a sentence. The underline is always present, never hover-only: touch surfaces have no hover, so a hover-revealed underline would leave the link carried by colour alone. The underline values are the prototype's.

At restbare a (tokens.css): 1px thick, 2px below the text, border-1 #DCDCD8
Hoverunderline goes to Ink #0A0A0A
…you can champion your own.Inline: Inter, Emerald #047857, underlined. Live link: hover it.

The wordmark beside live text

Both at 40 px. The file is outlined from the font, so it needs no font and carries the emerald tittle; the live text matches its letters once Inter has loaded, but keeps the font's own i dots.
